Wann hat sich der Mehrpreis des E-Autos: When has the EV paid off its extra cost? Extra cost = purchase price EV − price of a comparable combustion car − subsidies. The total savings (fuel, vehicle tax, GHG) are added up month by month; the dashboard shows how much has already been recovered and when the rest is likely to be reached. Without a purchase price for the EV the payback stays hidden.

Wichtig: Bei den kWh-Feldern die Sensore: Important: for the kWh fields enter the sensors that count the energy charged into the car – not the total PV generation or the household grid supply. The entity ID applies to all data sources (PostgreSQL and Prometheus store it that way too); with InfluxDB add the name under which the sensor is stored there. No own meters for PV/grid into car? The templates (Node-RED, HA package, configuration.yaml or via helpers, without any YAML) calculate them from grid and wallbox power – then enter sensor.ev_ladung_pv and sensor.ev_ladung_netz. Dynamic electricity tariff? Optionally enter “Grid cost into car (€)” – a running cost meter, e.g. sensor.ev_ladung_netz_kosten from the template ev_netzkosten.yaml. Then the actual costs count instead of the electricity tariff. Unit: create kWh meters in kWh, not in Wh – the app does not convert, Wh values would be 1000 times too high. Renamed sensor? Separate several names with |, old one first – e.g. Ceed Kilometerstand | New name. The values of both names are merged.
